# kanithanj.ai

This page matches a short self-description to public software and engineering roles in your browser. Nothing you type leaves the page. This page never applies or sends on your behalf. A person must confirm, then open the posting themselves.

## Page tools

Use these tools after the page has loaded. On the first find_roles call, pass stateVersion 0. After that, pass the stateVersion last returned. A stale stateVersion is refused. While a person-confirm step is open, other tools are refused until it is answered.

- find_roles (Find roles): Fill the page form with a self-description and show matching roles in this browser. Nothing leaves the page. Does not apply or send. Inputs: stateVersion, description, goal, regions, remote, productOnly. Required: stateVersion.
- show_apply_pack (Show apply pack): Show a local apply pack for a role already on the page: public facts, the posting link, and a checklist. This page never applies or sends on your behalf. A person must confirm, then open the posting themselves. Inputs: id, apply, send. Required: id.
- tailor_cv (Tailor CV): Show a local outline of what to emphasize for a role already on the page, built from the text in the form and public posting facts. Nothing is sent. This is not a submitted CV. Inputs: id. Required: id.

## Regions and filters

regions is an optional array of: SE Sweden, EU (includes Sweden), UK United Kingdom, US United States, CA Canada, LATAM Latin America, APAC Asia-Pacific, MEA Middle East and Africa. If no region is picked, every place counts as a fit.

remote is one of: any, remote, hybrid, onsite. productOnly is a boolean that hides roles that look like agency or freelance work.

## How to use them

1. Call find_roles with stateVersion 0 and a description. Skip name, email and phone; they are not needed.
2. Pick an id from the result and call tailor_cv or show_apply_pack.
3. If apply or send is set on show_apply_pack, a person must confirm in the page, then open the posting themselves.

Full schemas: /llms-full.txt
